text:
2015年の前年増減を出すため、2014年のデータも含めて集計してから LAG で差分を取り、最後に2015〜2024年に絞ります。

```sql
WITH yearly AS (
  SELECT yearID, SUM(HR) AS total_hr
  FROM Batting
  WHERE yearID BETWEEN 2014 AND 2024
  GROUP BY yearID
),
diffed AS (
  SELECT yearID,
         total_hr,
         total_hr - LAG(total_hr) OVER (ORDER BY yearID) AS change_from_prev_year
  FROM yearly
)
SELECT yearID, total_hr, change_from_prev_year
FROM diffed
WHERE yearID BETWEEN 2015 AND 2024
ORDER BY yearID;
```
